observations.calibration: one input and one cancellation per fresh process, excluded
observations.readiness: original worker-ready identity after full composer observed and Return; no visible-bubble gate or added settle delay
observations.cleanup: one scripted second; original finished identity, followed by joined VTE app/measurement/Xvfb
observations.failure_policy: Retain every outcome, no replacement. Missing cleanup stops remaining cases as NOT_RUN.

host.display: Owned Xvfb software-rendered native GTK/VTE, not physical display

limits: No provider/model/account/clipboard/IME/assistive technology or human task evaluation.
Within-process observations share one startup; each scenario uses a fresh app/display.
Fixed alternating AB/BA scenario order; single run per arm/scenario, no confidence interval or stable speedup assertion.
Shared-host scheduling and other callers remain uncontrolled; load captured around each scenario.
No deliberate model calls or broad source test cohort during this comparison; focused development tests may overlap and will be noted.
Fresh extracted source trees; Python bytecode cache may warm across scenarios.
Unchanged measure.py/probe_app.py; source parameter and owned cleanup changed only in supervisor, aggregate driver new.
Completion/exit status is separate from threshold success.
